Total ≈ 565 kcal

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 360 g of mostly fruit and cheese on a 26 cm plate at about 60% coverage is plausible. The cheese and sausage drive most of the energy, so the estimate is reasonable within roughly ±25%.
